messages.subject: error with eDMR - plot.drm.distr function
parts:
Hello,

I'm running edmr and all works fine until I get to plotting the dmr annotations, where I get the following:

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) :
  could not find function "plot.dmr.distr"

I cannot find this function in the source code so far (but it is on the google code page under 'usage'). Your help would be much appreciated.


Thanks
Helen

If you are using earlier version, it should still be plot.dmr.distr
